title: Fluidd console: hide the internal technical lines (timelapse echo, AI status code)
actions: [{"id": "tweaked-timelapse-frame", "name": "Timelapse frame (hidden by Tweaked)", "value": "MACRO=TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME VARIABLE=takingframe"}, {"id": "tweaked-ai-code", "name": "AI status code (hidden by Tweaked)", "value": "VARIABLE=qdc_ai_error_code"}]
note: Fluidd's console shows two lines nobody needs: the echo of a command the timelapse sends after every frame (one line per layer), and the AI service's status code (SAVE_VARIABLE ... qdc_ai_error_code, e.g. noodle=0 status=0) every time it restarts. This adds two 'contains' filters to Fluidd's console filters (Fluidd settings > Console, stored in Moonraker's database on the printer, so every browser) which only HIDE those lines from the display; nothing is deleted from the printer's log. Your own filters stay, a filter you switch off stays off, and uninstall puts the saved list back as it was. The readable messages stay: 'Timelapse is on: layer N/total' (timelapse-progress-note) and 'PEI foreign object check: ...'. Reload an open Fluidd page once.
